title: Chicken Braise with Italian Flair
description: A classic Italian-inspired dish featuring tender chicken, kissed by the flavors of Venezuelan spices and slow-cooked in a rich braise.
instructions: 1. Season the chicken breast with Italian seasoning, venezuelan spices, and salt.
2. In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
3. Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
4. Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
5. Add the garlic to the pot and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
6. Add the kissed tomatoes, chicken broth, and red wine to the pot.
7. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
8. Return the chicken to the pot and transfer to the oven.
9. Braise the chicken in the oven at 300°F (150°C) for 1 1/2 hours, or until tender.
10. While the chicken is braising, cook the bacon in a skillet until crispy.
11. Chop the bacon into small pieces and set aside.
12. Remove the chicken from the pot and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
13. Serve the chicken with the braising liquid spooned over the top and garnished with fresh parsley and crispy bacon.
